issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' repeated 7 times, causing entire root to switch to client rendering. This is likely caused by dynamic content rendered differently on server vs client (e.g., date/time like 'Good evening, Amelia.' greeting which depends on time of day, or 'Thursday, April 16' date string).
issues.element: Greeting text 'Good evening, Amelia.' and/or date 'Thursday, April 16'
issues.root_cause: The dashboard page likely renders a time-based greeting ('Good evening') or a dynamic date string directly during SSR without suppressing hydration mismatch or wrapping in a client-only component. The server renders at one time, the client renders at slightly different time or with different locale, causing mismatch.

issues.description: Console shows 'Invalid or unexpected token' page error which may indicate a syntax error in a source file affecting the dashboard page.
issues.root_cause: A syntax error in apps/web/app/dashboard/page.tsx or a component it imports. Could be an unterminated string, bad template literal, or invalid JSX token.

issues.description: Dining Room card title is truncated as 'Dining Room Curatio...' and tags are cut off ('NATU...'), indicating overflow issues in the card layout.
issues.root_cause: The cards section likely uses a flex/grid layout where the third card is partially outside the viewport without proper overflow handling or the card title lacks truncation CSS.
